artworks.title: Orage à la Fin du jour
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on chine collé [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water stretching into the distance from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A stone bridge crosses a waterway with a pathway next to it, where a figure on horseback is visible. On the right side, there are dense clusters of trees with intricate foliage. The sky is depicted with fine lines, suggesting a cloudy day. The artwork is in monochrome, using black and white to convey depth and detail.

artworks.title: Orage à la Fin du jour
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on chine collé
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from slightly above. The horizon is low in the composition, revealing a distant waterscape. On the left, there is a calm body of water with clusters of vegetation. On the right, there is a heavily textured area of foliage and tall trees. In the distance on the right, a small stone bridge arches over a waterway, next to which a lone rider on horseback is traveling along a narrow path. The color palette consists of primarily rich, earthy browns and blacks with lighter highlights.

artworks.title: The School of Rome
artworks.medium: pen and ink and wash over chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate interior scene featuring sculptures, paintings, and architectural details. The room is filled with figures engaged in various activities surrounded by classical motifs. Details include statues on pedestals, a decorated ceiling with frescoes and carvings, and walls adorned with framed artworks. The setting suggests a scholarly or artistic environment with figures in dynamic poses, indicating discussion and creative expression. The focus is on capturing an academic ambiance reminiscent of historical studios and lecture halls.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in various poses. In the center, a child lies on the ground with lines radiating from them. A man kneels to the left, facing the child, and a woman kneels to the right. Surrounding them are smaller kneeling, haloed figures with wings. Two additional figures are on the left, one kneeling with a staff, and the other standing. On the right, another figure kneels with a staff, near a donkey and an ox. A dog is in the foreground. The background shows outlines of trees and hills in a minimalist style.

artworks.title: Chronophotograph of a Man on a Bicycle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and David Robinson

artworks.title: The Ramasseum of El-Kurneh, Thebes, First View
artworks.description: The image shows large ancient sculptures featuring figures standing alongside a fallen head. The upright statues are in an ancient Egyptian style, with arms crossed on the chest. They are made from a light-colored stone and appear weathered. The fallen head on the ground is colossal, with detailed carvings including a headdress and distinct facial features. The sculptures are consistent in material. People and a camel in the foreground provide scale, indicating the sculptures are larger than life-size. The scene includes people interacting with the site.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: etching touched by the artist in red chalk, brown pen and ink, and graphite on laid paper [working proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. Figures are gathered around a child with two cherubs descending from the sky. The image shows people in flowing garments, one elder figure kneeling and presenting a vessel to a seated woman holding a child. The composition includes classical architectural elements like stone arches and a partially constructed wooden beam structure. The background features additional figures and trees, with two cherubs flying among clouds and rays of light in the upper portion of the scene. The delicate line work and shading give a sense of depth and movement, consistent with a baroque style of drawing.

artworks.title: An Elegant Young Woman in Maltese Costume
artworks.medium: pastel with touches of white gouache on parchment (stretched around wood)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a three-quarter profile facing left. She wears a long black gown with a black shawl over her head and shoulders. She has delicate features, dark brown hair styled in curls, and wears a choker necklace. Additionally, she holds a blue wrap in her hands, and her gown has gold embroidery. The background is a muted brown color.

artworks.title: Rue Saint-Jacques
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow, cobblestone street in a city with buildings on both sides. There are advertisements and signs on the buildings. The street ascends slightly into the distance, disappearing into bright light. The scene is in black and white, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts. Sunlight illuminates the ground, creating sharp shadows.

artworks.title: Stanislaus Sabinus von Stracza
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a seated position with one hand on a staff and the other on his hip. He has a long, bushy beard and a serious expression. The man is bald with hair circling the back of his head. He is adorned in elaborate armor with intricate designs and patterns. Surrounding him is an oval frame within a larger composition featuring various figures, cherubs, and mythical scenes. The background includes cherubs, angels, and a central figure resembling a deity or celestial being. Latin inscriptions are present within the composition.

artworks.title: Attilius Regulus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 11.4 x 7.2 cm (4 1/2 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored individuals gathered around a large barrel containing a man's head. The central figure is pushing the large barrel which features spikes and a visage inside. The background includes foliage, trees, and a distant castle. The hatching and line work create a tactile quality throughout the composition, emphasizing textures of clothing and nature. The work is reminiscent of engravings from the Northern Renaissance.

artworks.title: The Battle of Spoleto
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a charioteer driving a team of horses. The artwork is composed using red chalk, with a background suggesting a landscape. The drawing conveys movement and tension through loose but energetic lines, typical of preparatory sketches.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image shows a crucifixion scene with three crosses, each with a figure. Below the crosses, there is a group of individuals in poses of grief and prayer. The lines are fluid and expressive, capturing emotion and movement. The figures include standing and reclining forms with draped clothing. The artwork uses a singular, reddish color, contributing to a dramatic and somber tone.

artworks.title: A Young Woman Looking in a Mirror
artworks.medium: red chalk with black and white chalk on oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-body sketch of a person in a dynamic pose, bending forward with their arms extended across the front of their body. The person's head is tilted to the side, with loosely sketched facial features. Their hair is styled in a loose manner. The clothing is detailed with fabric folds, suggesting a full, flowing dress or garment. The sketch is on textured paper, with a plain background. There are no visible jewelry or distinct objects visible.

artworks.title: A Good Story
artworks.medium: platinum print mounted on gray wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 15.1 x 18.9 cm (5 15/16 x 7 7/16 in.)
mount: 16 x 19.6 cm (6 5/16 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people sitting on a porch. They are positioned in a relaxed manner, some seated in rocking chairs while others are standing or sitting casually. The individuals have different hairstyles and are dressed in early 20th-century attire. No visible jewelry or objects are held by them. The background includes a covered wooden porch and a serene natural setting with a body of water and trees.

artworks.title: Beauty is Truth--Truth Beauty
artworks.medium: photogravure in sepia overmatted and mounted on green wove paper

artworks.title: Portrait of Miss Jones
artworks.medium: photogravure on chine collé mounted on white paper and on dark gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, seated upright and facing the camera. The individual has dark, wavy hair and wears an ornate hat with feathers and flowers. They have a high-collared blouse with a white scarf, and a patterned jacket with stars. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Grand Garde (Souvenir du siège de Paris)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cloaked figure in a rural setting. In the foreground, there is a figure cloaked in heavy fabric, navigating rugged terrain with a stick in hand. The background features a small structure with classical columns and a symmetrical facade. The landscape includes barren trees, overgrown foliage, and planks arranged as a bridge. The line work shows attention to detail in capturing textures of natural elements and the figure's attire.

artworks.title: Dodo Arranging Her Hair
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body line drawing of a person seated on a chair. The person is in a semi-profile view, with their head turned slightly to the side. Their facial features are delicately sketched, with subtle details indicating closed eyes and a neutral expression. The individual's hair is drawn in short strokes, suggesting a tousled style. They appear to be adjusting their hair with both hands. The person is wearing a flowing garment that drapes around their form. The legs are highlighted with patterned stockings or leggings. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background features a textured surface with abstract shapes and shading.

artworks.title: Karnak (Thèbes), Palais--Salle hypostyle--Colonnade Centrale--Décoration d'un Fut
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George and Alexandra Stephanopoulos
artworks.description: The sculpture is a relief carving on a large stone column. The relief depicts human figures in profile wearing ancient Egyptian attire and headwear. Hieroglyphics are carved around and alongside the figures. The material is stone, with a light sandy beige color. The figures are depicted in a formal, stylized manner typical of Egyptian art.

artworks.title: Barcha del Hercole
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ship with mythical decorations. The ship is adorned with dragon figureheads emitting smoke or steam. Figures in ancient armor line the sides, some holding spears upright. The deck is crowded with these figures. The stern is elevated with grand carvings, featuring a figure with a staff. Minimal detail is given to the water. The drawing has a historical period interpretation with a strong linear quality typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Anfione Argon condotto da Mercurio
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological ship. The drawing depicts a fantastical vessel adorned with ornate sculptures and decorations. A figure labeled "Mercurio" is shown standing at the prow of the ship with a winged helmet and caduceus. Another figure, "Anfone," is depicted at the stern in armor holding a scepter. The ship is populated with figures in classical attire, holding shields and banners. Smoke or mist surrounds the ship as it glides over the water, with distant landscapes visible in the background.
